          CI: true

          CI: true

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint

  build:
    needs: [test, lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: packages/warp-widget/dist/

  publish:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: packages/warp-widget/dist/
      - run: npm publish
        working-directory: packages/warp-widget
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
